"""Load byte-exact review-head masks and numeric extractor for public-gate probes."""

from pathlib import Path


def pytest_configure(config):
    from axiom_encode.harness import (
        manual_locator_metadata,
        source_completeness,
        validator_pipeline,
    )

    snapshots = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "r6"
    for module, filename in (
        (manual_locator_metadata, "manual_locator_metadata_old.py"),
        (validator_pipeline, "pre_collision_validator.py"),
        (source_completeness, "source_completeness_old.py"),
    ):
        path = snapshots / filename
        exec(compile(path.read_text(), str(path), "exec"), module.__dict__)
